previous_sql: SELECT card_scheme, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN auth_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS tasa_de_aprobacion FROM v_attempt_dedup WHERE NOT is_test GROUP BY card_scheme ORDER BY tasa_de_aprobacion DESC
question: dame la tasa de aprobación en porcentaje de cada esquema de tarjeta, ordenada de mayor a menor
sql: SELECT d.card_scheme, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.auth_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS tasa_de_aprobacion FROM v_attempt_dedup f JOIN dim_card d ON f.card_sk = d.card_sk WHERE NOT f.is_test GROUP BY d.card_scheme ORDER BY tasa_de_aprobacion DESC
